While our 90% confidence intervals cover a broad range of plausible outcomes, certain high-impact events could push actual outcomes beyond these bounds. These "tail risks" are less likely but represent scenarios that could fundamentally alter the trajectory beyond what's captured in our standard probabilistic assessment.
